import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1 = 1000000007L;
    static final long MOD2 = 998244353L;
    static final int MAX_DEPTH = 7;
    static final long BASE_NUM = 1000000L;

    static long max_number;
    static long order_idx;
    static int total_answer;
    static int[] prefix_sum_array = new int[MAX_DEPTH];
    static List<Integer>[] digit_collection = new ArrayList[MAX_DEPTH];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DEPTH; i++) {
            digit_collection[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void build_sequence(long start_value, int level) {
        order_idx++;
        int val = (int)(((order_idx - start_value) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2);
        digit_collection[level].add(val);
        prefix_sum_array[level] = (int)((prefix_sum_array[level] + val) % MOD1);
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            build_sequence(start_value * 10 + digit, level + 1);
        }
    }

    static void traverse_number(long x) {
        if (x > max_number) return;
        if (x * BASE_NUM + BASE_NUM - 1 <= max_number && x * BASE_NUM * 10 > max_number) {
            long saved_order = order_idx;
            for (int depth = 0, factor = 1; depth <= 6; depth++, factor *= 10) {
                int size = digit_collection[depth].size();
                int diff = (int)(((saved_order - x * factor) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2);
                int target = (int)((MOD2 - diff) % MOD2);
                int position = lowerBound(digit_collection[depth], target);
                total_answer = (int)((total_answer + (long)diff * size + prefix_sum_array[depth]) % MOD1);
                total_answer = (int)((total_answer - (long)MOD2 * (size - position) % MOD1 + MOD1) % MOD1);
                order_idx += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        order_idx++;
        total_answer = (int)((total_answer + ((order_idx - x) % MOD2 + MOD2) % MOD2) % MOD1);
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            traverse_number(x * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        max_number = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        order_idx = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_DEPTH; i++) {
            digit_collection[i].clear();
            prefix_sum_array[i] = 0;
        }
        build_sequence(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digit_collection[i]);
        }
        order_idx = 0;
        total_answer = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            traverse_number(i);
        }
        System.out.println(total_answer);
    }
}
